events.text: Follow-through found the reported Bald Head package already persists the pre-fix auto-generated Imported Texture UV table. Add a provenance-versioned in-place refresh so the fix reaches that existing untouched generated variant without overwriting authored base paint.

Fixed the embedded-GLB mapping regression shown on Bald Head. Native import now snapshots exact absolute TEXCOORD_0 corners before setPaintTarget overwrites the mesh UV lanes, then applies the owned image/corner pair after quad grouping and paint-layout setup. Existing packages are covered too: imported-texture provenance now versions the UV contract, and a missing-version v1 automatic row is refreshed in place on the next source load while authored variants/base paint remain untouched because Save-back strips provenance. Native source-snapshot and TypeScript migration regressions pass, as do test-mesh-import, test-model-paint, all five paint-variant tests, and the ReleaseFast editor build.
